protocol.frozen_before: Any scored training or test-set inspection for this follow-up
protocol.question: Does continuously replacing white covariance by smooth GP covariance change the MLP/S4 comparison under the original univariate instance-normalized geometry?
protocol.mixture: A single Gaussian with K_alpha=(1-alpha)I+alpha K_RBF/(variance+nugget); equivalent to sqrt(1-alpha)*independent white + sqrt(alpha)*independent GP. Not a categorical mixture or a linear amplitude blend. Unit marginal source variance at all alpha.
protocol.endpoint_caveat: GP endpoint differs from original raw-kernel source by division by 1.000001, keeping marginal variance exactly equal across the sweep. Raw target generator is unchanged.
protocol.independence: Source and target independent; normalized source does not use paired history statistics. Independent train/val/test draws per data_seed.
protocol.geometry: Before training: both data draws must pass matched-GP velocity validation E2>0.90, white velocity E2<0.90, target within-patch std>0.02 and roughness>0.002. Intermediate sources are reported, not required to pass the GP gate.
protocol.architecture: Original small trainable lookback encoder; same initialization across heads, then trained independently. Same width56 and depth3 as original. Not a literal frozen shared encoder.
protocol.objective_control: At alpha1 cross original versus whitened input/output coordinates with raw versus PCA-balanced velocity loss. No PCA mean subtraction from velocity. Whitening retains all dimensions and uses original floor.
protocol.optimization: Equal fixed6000-update cosine LR schedule .001 to .0001; validation checkpoints chosen by each cell's own training objective. No hyperparameter selection from tests. Different objectives not compared numerically to select a winner. No convergence claim.
protocol.metrics: Original raw PC1/residual MSE, roughness and literal two-sided20% rule retained. Fixed train-target PCA errors support cross-source comparisons. Fair CRPS/energy on128 independent test contexts with32 draws; marginal coverage. Report source-specific label-noise/task differences.
protocol.gradients: Fixed validation probes, raw-MSE PC1/PC2/residual parameter-gradient contributions for head parameters, at initialization and later steps. Within-model ratios/cosines; not parameterization-invariant or proof of causation. Diagnostics do not select models.
protocol.inference: Within each of two independently drawn datasets, average3 paired optimization seeds. Show both dataset effects separately. No claim that6 runs are6 independent datasets. Alpha analyses exploratory; no test-selected best-alpha recommendation.
protocol.solver: Euler64 primary; seed41 each cell checked at128 on the first8 ensemble contexts using identical sources. Limited sensitivity check, not convergence proof.
